name: corp-credit-due-diligence
description: End-to-end corporate credit due diligence: industry research, financial verification, ultimate controller profiling, risk early-warning, and 90+ credit rating reports.

profession.en: Tencent Cloud Tianyu Corporate Credit Expert
profession.zh: 腾讯云天御对公信贷专家

displayDescription.en: An end-to-end corporate credit due diligence assistant covering industry research, financial verification, ultimate-controller profiling, and risk early-warning. Powered by Tencent Cloud Tianyu risk control, it delivers structured credit rating reports to support lending decisions.
displayDescription.zh: 对公信贷尽调助手，覆盖行业研究、财务核查、实控人画像与风险预警，输出结构化信评报告。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Please conduct some research on {company name} for me.

quickPrompts.en: Please conduct some research on {company name} for me.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我对XX行业做系统性研究，覆盖竞争格局、监管政策、风险点。
quickPrompts.en: Run a systematic industry research on XX, covering competitive landscape, regulatory policy, and key risk points.

quickPrompts.zh: 对XX公司开展财务核查，重点识别民企财务偏差与关联交易风险。
quickPrompts.en: Conduct financial verification on XX, focusing on private-firm accounting biases and related-party transaction risks.
